links.comparator_used: LLM-based retrieval without the evidence ledger layer (baseline not detailed in the abstract)
links.outcome: Stale citations and unverifiable citations in LLM retrieval outputs
links.effect: Stale citations fell from 14.7% to 1.2%. Unverifiable citations fell from 28.4% to 2.3%.
links.tradeoff: Rollback has a cost: p95 rollback takes 5.13 s at 78M assertions. No other burden is reported in the abstract.
links.quote: As an auditable memory layer for LLM-based retrieval, EviLedger reduces stale citations from 14.7% to 1.2% and unverifiable citations from 28.4% to 2.3%, while supporting p95 rollback in 5.13 s at 78M assertions.

design_hint: auditable evidence ledger as retrieval memory layer with drift monitoring and rollback
